overview.description: The Amplify Stablecoin Technology Leaders ETF (STBQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. Constituents are selected by market-cap and assets under management (AUM). STBQ was launched on Dec 22, 2025 and is issued by Amplify Investments.
